run_clm_training_default: run a default CLM language model training job using the training config JSON file
run_clm_training_sft: run an SFT supervised fine-tuning training job for a language model using the config file
run_clm_training_reward: run a reward model training job for a language model using the training config file
run_clm_training_dpo: run a DPO direct preference optimization training job for a language model using the config
run_clm_training_orpo: run an ORPO odds ratio preference optimization training job for a language model using the config
